title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Update with single-vote deduplication, clean UI, and native background notifications!
releaseNotes: Strict single-vote deduplication across devices (app vs web)
Clean, clutter-free in-app UX without intrusive popup banners
Firebase Cloud Firestore real-time database integration
Native background notifications for meal polls (runs even when app is killed)
Automatic 5-minute reminder alarms until votes are cast
